notes.title: Tomorrow on Save & Sound (+ a link to a concert teaser)!
notes.content:
Hi! An announcement to remind you that tomorrow, I'll show some exclusive content to the Save & Sound event here on Steam at 12PM PDT. I recorded a video game concert little session for the occasion!

[h3]Because what happened since the last demo I released two years ago and a failed Kickstarter?[/h3]

Well, in 2020/2021 I decided to shelve the dev of the game for a while, focusing on other kind of job, developing some audio plugins extensions in LUA, blablabla...

And in 2022, Epic announced that I had a Megagrant to help me work on the game!

[h3]The concert[/h3]

The thing is that I really wanted to create an whole experience with this game, so I decided to develop a different version of it, which I would control with electronic music hardware for a live video game concert!
I worked on it for a bit more than 6 months, and I played it in May 2023, at the Stunfest festival in France. It was so cool! What I want, is to propose a game-album and the concert belonging to it.
Here's the teaser of the concert:

[previewyoutube=ZoDZ5KaLIyM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What about the game?[/h3]

If you reading this, that's because you just discovered the game or you're interested since I released the demo.
The demo is outdated, there are mentions of the Kickstarter, which failed. I worked on the game content but not so much, as I developed the concert. I worked mainly on the main system, to optimize it and facilitate development.
I just started to change the whole audio system, as I'll work with Unreal Engine 5 and Metasound, and this will be so fun!
I still have a lot to do to change the audio system and I also have to work on a lot of content.

I'm not sure of any release date for the moment, I have a family to take care of, and I have some other projects during this year. Teaching, making experimental video games with dance companies, I'm also the president of the House of Video Games here in Rennes (France) which is a super cool place for people to work, talk about and share gaming/dev experiences.

I believe I'll have a final version during 2024.

I'll keep you in touch, and meanwhile I'll try to tour with this fun concert.

Thank you for following, and don't hesitate to share the project!

notes.title: Save & Sound - A celebration of music in games is going live September 11 - 14!
notes.content:
[h2]Get ready![/h2]

Join us September 11 - 14 right here on Steam for one of the largest digital expos about audio and music in games. Save & Sound features concerts, deep-dives, and mashups from 70+ developers from around the world!

Starting at 10am PDT / 7pm CEST, a 3-day live show from September 11 - 13 will showcase original content made just for Save & Sound. 

[b]I decided to make a custom concert for the occasion, recorded in my office![/b]

[h2]Don’t miss out on updates![/h2]

Set a reminder to be notified when Save & Sound will go live!

The show will be streamed on the Save & Sound website, YouTube, and Twitch. Check out all the games part of the event on [url=saveandsound.io]saveandsound.io[/url]

notes.title: New interactive music experience for free + Patreon!
notes.content:
Hi there! It has been two months since the Kickstarter campaign launched and failed.

I had to take over and make something new, interesting, fresh and sustainable to be able able to continue the development of Square Paper City.

I then decided to create a [url=https://www.patreon.com/tomavatars]Patreon[/url]!


Why? Because I think it's the best way for me to dev Square Paper along creating other quick works, show to the world that I have a lot to express and to share.

So here are all the rewards I'm proposing to Patrons:

[list]
[*] Discord benefits
[*] Exclusive Patreon updates
[*] Your name in the credits of my Video Games and Players
[*] Track of the week (draft)
[*] Hyperun Interactive and Procedural Music Player (Win/Mac)
[*] Bi Monthly Playhear Interactive Music Player (Win/Mac)
[*] Decide of the tracks I'll use for the Playhears I'm making and other kind of votes
[*] VST Patches of the month
[*] Sound Effects of the month
[*] 1hr monthly private tutorials (in group): Computer Music and Sound Design, Unreal Engine, Fmod Studio (interactive audio)...
[*] Early access to my games and other projects
[*] These depends on the tiers you choose of course.
[/list]

I suggest the Triangle tier, as I'm promising one Playhear Interactive Music player every two months!

As a final note, to celebrate this, here is the first [url=https://tomavatars.itch.io/playhear-player-one]Playhear Player[/url] for free, for everybody!

Have a nice day, and thank you again for your support!

notes.title: Square Paper City demo/EP out now for the Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[h3]That's it! You can now try the demo of Square Paper City for the Steam Next Fest![/h3]

A demo? More of an immersive EP.
My game is all about being an album to be played like a video game.

There is still the Kickstarter going on and it's far from being successful, so if you liked the demo, you can head over [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tomavatars/square-paper-city-a-music-album-playable-as-a-video-game]here[/url]!

Thank you so much!
